import sys

def scan_int():
    return int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())

def scan_ints(n):
    line = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    return [int(x) for x in line[:n]]

def print_int(x):
    print(x)

def print_int_no_newline(x):
    print(x, end='')

def solve():
    n = scan_int()
    arr = scan_ints(n)
    arr.sort()
    
    t = scan_int()
    
    i = 0
    j = 0
    max_window = 0
    
    while j < n:
        while j < n and arr[j] - arr[i] <= t:
            j += 1
        max_window = max(max_window, j - i)
        i += 1
    
    print_int(max_window)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
